name: Line cross
oneLiner: two glowing lines draw over time while the camera rides their heads with live values beside them; the heads meet, hold a beat, the crossing point pops with a ring and a glass pill names when it happened, then the brand line runs on above and the camera pulls back
say: when the speaker says one thing overtook another over time ('by month eight we passed them', 'that is when AI got cheaper than hiring'): cut in on the comparison, the crossing pops on the word that names the moment
